method: Each preview's sky footprint is measured from the WCS of its source FITS: field size from the pixel scale and shape, centre from the middle pixel. CRVAL is deliberately not used, because for a cutout taken from a larger tile it is the projection reference and can sit far outside the image.
placementSemantics: Every measured layer is placeable: its rectangle comes from its own WCS. Needing a transform is not a defect, and a repositioned layer is no less correctly registered than one that happened to share the base framing.
